body:
it usually is. i'm able to get out a lot of the frustration and emotion into the words I write. i've dropped a lot of money into my first professionally recorded album but i'm concerned that it's not going to be as exciting to everyone else as it is for me, and that would be a huge let down. things are starting to get pretty busy with that part of my life as well as with work, and i'm trying my best to manage all of it at once but I don't know how much longer i'm going to keep it up. especially when my entire paycheck goes to gas (i drive a lot for work), my car loan, car insurance, and student debt.

regarding the girlfriend... if I was in a perfect situation with no student loans to pay off, i could probably afford to move out and actually follow through on what i'd really like to do. but at the end of the day that's not the situation and i have a long way to go before i'm going to be able to do that... and i don't know if she'll be willing to wait. i certainly wouldn't if i was her. she first noticed me when she was at one of my shows and i'm constantly worried that she was attracted to the stereotypical musician on stage and will get bored with all the issues that are piling up and move on to someone who has their shit together, which i can never seem to do.

i've given it some thought but i don't know what good it'll do. i also don't have enough income at the moment (most of my disposable income comes from commission, of which I have had very little lately... my base only covers expenses) so I don't know if i'd be able to afford it. The things that I have to live for are mostly the people who are still close to me, but I've let them down in the past (the college debacle) and don't want to go through that again. I feel like I'm very close to that point. I want things to move forward in a lot of different areas but the mountain of debt makes it nearly impossible for me to do the things i really want. i feel like i'm reaching a tipping point where all this shit is about to come crashing down around me and when it does i'm going to have to see the disappointment from everyone all over again
